title: A Hybrid Exact-Heuristic Solver for the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation Problem
abstract: arXiv:2611.22043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We describe the solver we submitted to the second round of the SOICT 2026 contest on the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation problem, a selective pickup-and-delivery routing problem with time windows, open routes and heterogeneous taxis. The solver is a single-file, standard-library Python program that combines (i) a constant-time insertion test based on latest-arrival slack, (ii) greedy insertion, local search and an Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search (ALNS) with simulated-annealing acceptance, and (iii) an exact route-selection engine that enumerates, for every taxi, the best feasible route for each request set and then solves the resulting set-packing problem by branch-and-bound strengthened with route-based large neighborhood search, Lagrangian bounds and reduced-cost fixing. The engine is chosen automatically from the instance size, and an independent verifier and a watchdog guarantee that a valid answer is always printed

translated_title: 乘客与包裹联合运输问题的精确-启发式混合求解器
translated_abstract: 我们描述了提交给SOICT 2026竞赛第二轮“乘客与包裹联合运输问题”的求解器，该问题是一个带时间窗、开放路线和异构出租车的选择性取送货路径规划问题。该求解器是一个仅依赖标准库的单文件Python程序，结合了：(i) 基于最晚到达时间裕量的常数时间插入测试；(ii) 贪心插入、局部搜索以及采用模拟退火接受准则的自适应大邻域搜索（ALNS）；(iii) 一个精确路线选择引擎，该引擎为每辆出租车枚举每个请求集的最佳可行路线，随后用分支定界法求解由此产生的集合装箱问题，并通过基于路线的大邻域搜索、拉格朗日界和削减成本固定法加以强化。引擎根据问题实例规模自动选择，同时独立的验证器和看门狗机制确保始终输出有效答案。
tldr: 该论文提出一个融合常数时间插入测试、自适应大邻域搜索与精确集合装箱引擎（分支定界结合拉格朗日界强化）的混合求解器，用于求解带时间窗、开放路线和异构出租车的乘客与包裹联合运输问题。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a hybrid exact-heuristic solver combining constant-time insertion tests, ALNS with simulated-annealing acceptance, and an exact set-packing engine (branch-and-bound strengthened by Lagrangian bounds) for the Integrated Passenger and Parcel Transportation Problem.
